Combine the reusable-result cache with quality processing in one extraction configuration.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"enable_quality_processing\":true,\"use_cache\":true}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].quality_score)

asyncio.run(main())
```
